title: Gender and Positional Biases in LLM-Based Hiring Decisions: Evidence from Comparative CV/Résumé Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative evaluation of synthetic CV pairs where candidate names (male vs. female), explicit gender fields, and pronouns are systematically swapped to measure selection preferences.
Analysis of model selection rates based on the order in which candidates appear in the prompt (first vs. second) to determine if presentation order influences decisions.
